features: Only previous UTC days, 365-day maximum 20-match goal form, prior-day Elo (1500, K20, home60, scale400, annual shrink .15), league-wide previous-year home/away scoring rates to adapt to scoring era. No xG, odds, future lineups, or target-day outcomes. Regular league only; no playoffs.
fit: Training-only joint Poisson/Dixon-Coles likelihood, goal attack/defence and signed Elo, home/away intercepts around observed prior-year league rates. Optional bounded exponential tilts of the shared score distribution for over 2.5, BTTS and draw. Coefficients regularized, no market uses a contradictory separate score distribution.
selectionRule: Among candidates satisfying selection gates, minimize equal-weight sum of candidate/baseline log loss, 1X2 Brier, over2.5 Brier and BTTS Brier. Select exactly one per league before opening holdout or audits. If none eligible, record best candidate as rejected.
uncertainty: Weekly paired block bootstrap 1000 replicates, seed 20260928; report intervals, never optimize them.
runtime: Exactly the same regular-match parsing, day cutoff, league-rate features and distribution. At least five matches per team, latest <=120 days, >=180 prior-year league matches, fresh complete current feed; otherwise preserve existing model.
prohibitions: No repeated selection from holdout/audit outcomes
No claim that unseen 2012–2013 was part of earlier experiments
No candidate promotion without all gates
